provenanceNote: Hand-authored capstone of the Economics 101 series (2026-08-25). Grounds the operator's own long-standing argument (Bitcointalk 'In Response to Peter Schiff', topic 5582327) — buybacks as commitment, education over speculation, utility/spendability (marsresident), and DevCoin's oversupply failure. The differentiator: no coin dev has made teaching AND practicing this economics a point; MELEK does both. See memory economics-teaching-source-and-differentiator. HARD compliance: educational only, not investment advice, no price predictions, buybacks framed as treasury discipline never a price promise.
